injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN rep
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
